verdict.rationale: Thoropass is a compliance SaaS platform, so asking for an interactive API reference is a fair question. The evidence pack documents only an MCP server, an llms.txt help-center index, and an AI helpbot. There is no public API reference, no interactive explorer, and no runnable examples. The MCP server and llms.txt are adjacent features and earn no credit for this story.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can explore an interactive API reference with runnable examples
